topic: Why does a milk tanker shove forward after braking (milk vs fuel tanker)?
notes: user request Nov 22. Title card: THE SLOSHING TRUCK. Suggested hook: You are in a car behind a milk tanker and when it brakes the whole truck shoves forward. Compare with a fuel tanker.
